mci.title: FY27 Frontier Accelerate MCI Guide (AMM summary deck, 2026–2027)
mci.edition: 29-slide summary incl. India (Market C) Security tables
mci.authority: Summary — used for quick reference and India-specific tables

discrepancies.detail: The CPI guide (pp. 100, 312) requires partners to meet the minimum incremental ACR on at least 60% of Partner Nominated post-sales claims. The MCI summary deck headline states 80% (slides 14, 16) but its own governance slide repeats 60% for Partner Nominated offers. The advisor uses 60%; 80% is shown as the Marketplace governance monitor.

discrepancies.topic: Core M&M with MDC / Sentinel nomination threshold
discrepancies.detail: Specialized offer text says ≥40% of incremental ACR on MDC/Sentinel (p. 129); the SMB offer says ≥4% (p. 165). The published MDC ACR minimums ($200 on $5K … $10K on $250K) equal 4% of each band floor, so the advisor tests the dollar minimum and flags the 40% wording.

discrepancies.topic: AI Apps, Agents & Developer XXS Market B
discrepancies.detail: CPI guide p. 135 lists $2,000 for both Market A and Market B at XXS, unlike every other standard ladder ($1,600). The advisor shows the guide value and flags it.

discrepancies.topic: Defender for Cloud Deployment Accelerator — India table
discrepancies.detail: The MCI deck India slide repeats the Sentinel payout table for MDC. The CPI guide (p. 89) sets MDC S/M/L Stage 1 lower than Sentinel (Market C: $3,750 / $8,750 / $18,750). The advisor uses the CPI guide.

discrepancies.topic: Enterprise and Biz Apps Presales Advisor terms
discrepancies.detail: Both engagements in the guide run 1 Oct 2025 – 30 Sep 2026, which has now ended. FY27 terms had not been published in the 3 Sep 2026 export. Treat these calculators as indicative until the next guide drop.
